newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's NLB bank says 1996 net up 19.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's NLB bank says 1996 net up 19.1 pct.

text.p: Slovenia's largest bank, the state-owned Nova Ljubljanska Banka d.d. (NLB), said on Wednesday 1996 net profit rose to 5.6 billion tolars ($36.2 million) from 4.7 billion in 1995.
The bank said higher profits were due to a 27 percent growth in deposits, a 17 percent increase in loans and a decline in debts at the central bank to 2.1 billion tolars from 15.6 billion.
NLB's balance sheet assets rose 12.6 percent to 518.2 billion tolars from 460.1 billion in 1995. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
